name: Farro
siboNotes: High fructan content makes farro problematic for SIBO patients. Consider avoiding during elimination phase and reintroduce cautiously during maintenance if tolerated.
preparationTips: Soaking overnight may help reduce cooking time but won't significantly lower FODMAP content
Start with very small portions if reintroducing after elimination phase
Pair with low-FODMAP proteins and vegetables to balance the meal
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein (about 7g per cooked cup)
